decision: PHASE 09N PAN FAN FLD PROTEST WORKFLOW SCAFFOLD PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
baseCommit: 6119ddd PHASE-09M-BIR-NOTICE-LOA-TRIAGE-INTENT-SCAFFOLD-1 add BIR notice/LOA triage intent scaffold
objective: Provide a design-only, non-runtime-active scaffold modeling the Philippine BIR administrative assessment-defense workflow (PAN, consolidated PAN, FAN, consolidated FAN, FLD, FAN/FLD, FDDA, protest, reconsideration, reinvestigation, action on protest, CTA appeal-watch) after the BIR notice triage layer detects an assessment notice, without generating final legal conclusions or filing-ready protest documents. This scaffold models workflow; it does not decide.

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: sales reclassified from zero-rated to exempt.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: sales are properly zero-rated export sales.

CWT_SUBSTANTIATION_ISSUE.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. is assessed for unsupported creditable withholding tax. What is the workflow?

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: CWT claimed without matching BIR Form 2307.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: certificates were received late from withholding agents.

WITHHOLDING_TAX_DEDUCTIBILITY_ISSUE.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. is assessed for disallowed expenses due to withholding tax deductibility. What is the workflow?

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: expenses disallowed for lack of withholding.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: withholding was remitted under a different account code.

INPUT_VAT_SUBSTANTIATION_ISSUE.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. is assessed for disallowed input VAT. What is the workflow?

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: input VAT disallowed for invoicing deficiencies.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: supplier invoices substantially comply with invoicing rules.

DIVIDEND_FWT_ISSUE.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. is assessed for unremitted final withholding tax on dividends. What is the workflow?

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: dividend declared without corresponding FWT remittance.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: no dividend was actually declared or paid during the period.

LOA_OR_ELA_AUTHORITY_ISSUE.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. questions whether the underlying eLA authority was valid. What is the workflow?

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: assessment based on original eLA authority.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: eLA authenticity and scope require verification.

CONSOLIDATED_NOTICE_ISSUE.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. questions the consolidated notice covering multiple eLAs. What is the workflow?

assessmentIssues.birFinding: Synthetic finding: findings consolidated from two eLAs.
assessmentIssues.taxpayerPosition: Synthetic position: consolidation stage and service require verification.
